clauses.source_clause: Investigate failures with bounded evidence gathering and model judgment.

extract-flow.summary: Bounded incident investigation: collect evidence, form at least three hypotheses, probe cheapest-first, conclude with a causal chain or block honestly.

steps.description: Gather observable evidence for the failure.
At least three hypotheses, cheapest-to-disprove first.
Judge refutation; surviving hypothesis needs a causal chain.
At most three failed attempts, then block.
Completion requires a stated causal chain.
